title: ARENA: Automated Red-Teaming for Large Audio Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.15578v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) make it possible to interact with language models through speech, music, and environmental sound, but they also introduce a safety surface that is difficult to expose with text-only red-teaming. We study automated audio-grounded red-teaming, where a text query must remain safe in isolation while the joint text-audio input induces harmful target behavior. We propose ARENA, a closed-loop framework that trains a controller on an independent 2,000case text-audio dataset. MD-Judge supplies training rewards and adaptive search feedback, while a separate, non-adaptive Llama Guard 3 evaluator alone labels final outcomes. On 520 held-out AdvBench objectives, ARENA achieves FDR/PSR of 87.9/100.0%, 71.5/96.3%, 68.1/100.0%, and 75.4/98.5% on Audio Flamingo 3, Qwen2-Audio, MiMo-Audio, and GPTAudio, respectively. translated_title: ARENA：大型音频语言模型的自动化红队测试
translated_abstract: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）使得通过语音、音乐和环境声音与语言模型交互成为可能，但这也引入了一个仅通过文本红队测试难以暴露的安全表面。我们研究了自动化的音频基础红队测试，其中文本查询在单独时必须保持安全，而联合文本-音频输入会诱导有害的目标行为。我们提出了ARENA，一个闭环框架，它在独立的2000例文本-音频数据集上训练一个控制器。MD-Judge提供训练奖励和自适应搜索反馈，而一个独立的、非自适应的Llama Guard 3评估器仅用于标记最终结果。在520个保留的AdvBench目标上，ARENA在Audio Flamingo 3、Qwen2-Audio、MiMo-Audio和GPTAudio上分别实现了87.9/100.0%、71.5/96.3%、68.1/100.0%和75.4/98.5%的FDR/PSR。消融实验表明，基于反馈的细化和音频变体搜索显著提高了攻击性能。
tldr: 本文提出ARENA，一个自动化音频红队测试框架，通过闭环训练和音频-文本联合输入，在多种大型音频语言模型上实现了高成功率的安全攻击，显著优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ARENA, an automated audio-grounded red-teaming framework that achieves high success rates in attacking various large audio language models through closed-loop training and joint audio-text inputs, significantly outperforming existing methods.
